Our bread

Sourdough, rye and seeded loaves baked fresh every morning with flour milled in Sindh. We bake in small batches so every loaf is still warm when it reaches you.

About us

A family bakery in Karachi since 2019, open every day from seven in the morning until the bread runs out.
